diagnosis: Single-use authorization limits resolver calls but does not limit disclosure cardinality when the opened graph contains a stable equivalence-class identifier.
correction: Keep the stable duplicate commitment only in the pseudonymizer and public denominator ledger. Give the outcome holder an event-specific binding derived from the event handle and stable commitment, so one bridge reaches one outcome event.
